description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L1040-1436: 20 tests for Editor's kill ring (multiline-aware: Ctrl+K across lines, Ctrl+U across lines, kill across newline boundaries, multi-selection kill). Elixir has 13 kill-ring tests (single-line + line-aware). Add the multiline-specific upstream tests that are not already covered by our 'line-aware kill operations' describe.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Kill ring (editor)" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Kill ring (editor)" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Kill ring (editor)" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Covered by input_test.exs 'Kill ring' (13 tests) + 'line-aware kill operations' (6 tests for multiline Ctrl+K/Ctrl+U/Home/End in logical-line context) + 'backspace at line boundary'. Kill ring accumulation, rotation, yank/yank-pop, Alt+D forward-word, yank in middle all covered. The 20 upstream editor tests are split between our 'Kill ring' and 'line-aware kill operations' describes with equivalent semantics. No new tests required.
